title: Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering
author: Nick Liffen
description: Writing code got faster. The work around it didn't. See how you can plan, write code, review changes, and investigate production issues with GitHub Copilot, and what work still needs your judgment. The post Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: This October, GitHub saw more than 1.2 billion commits in one week—over 400% more than a year earlier. This is more commits than GitHub received in all of 2025.
takeaways: We’ll walk through what an effective agentic engineering workflow looks like on GitHub.
Use Copilot in Slack or Teams to collaborate with everyone involved—from product managers and designers to analysts and business stakeholders.
Use GitHub Agentic Workflows to label your issues and estimate task complexity.
